This document details the project's testing suite and its implementation. It includes final outputs for each test as confirmation of functionality for the main scripts. All pytest scripts were custom-written according to potential edge cases that are common in Markov Chain models. This document is organized by pytest scripts, with a short explanation of what each function is testing.
